_comment: Hand-curated override layer for the eq-model-catalog sync tool (Teil B, follow-up). The sync tool merges: OpenRouter /models (+ provider APIs) -> these overrides -> capability_catalog.json. Overrides win over auto-detected values. Use to (a) correct wrong auto-detected flags, (b) add Equitania-specific models/providers OpenRouter does not cover (e.g. Melious, IONOS), (c) pin curated display names/pricing. Not read at runtime by eq_chatbot_core; it is an input to the generator only.
